tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Best route and expected output for selling a specific amount of one token for another on one chain, priced from the pools LCX Liberty DEX indexes itself. Use it for what an amount would swap for; use get_price for a token's value, and search_tokens first to turn a ticker into an address. Read-only:

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Finds tokens on one chain by symbol, name or address, and gives the address get_quote and get_price need. Use it whenever you have a ticker or a name instead of an address. Read-only. Matching is case-insensitive on any part of the symbol, name or address; with no search it lists the chain's tokens.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: USD price of one whole token on one chain, priced from the pools LCX Liberty DEX indexes itself (real depth, not a mid-market feed). Use it for a token's value; use get_quote for what a specific amount would swap for, and search_tokens first to turn a ticker into an address. Read-only. Returns usd,

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Every chain LCX Liberty DEX serves, with the live health of its index. Call it to learn which chainId values the other tools accept and whether a chain is quoting right now, or to explain a refused or stale answer from get_quote or get_price. Read-only, takes no arguments, and does not count against

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: Reads the calling API key's own plan and usage, so no key or account id is passed. Use it to answer questions about quota or throttling, or before a long run of calls. Read-only, live, and it does not count against the quota. Returns plan and planLabel; callsUsed, monthlyCalls and callsRemaining for
